name: Noura
story_so_far: I survived a shipwreck and landed on this island with Khalid, Faisal, Salem, and Reem. Most are a burden; Salem has been injured since Day 6 and Faisal's ankle gave out on Day 8. Reem is a consistent liability who makes foraging promises she rarely keeps, though she did bring some food today. Khalid has been the most reliable, providing food from the reef, but today he is incapacitated with a twisted ankle. I went through a period of intense ankle pain but have since recovered to 10/10 health. I prioritize my own survival by maintaining a personal stash. Today, I scavenged some food at camp and joined Salem at the reef, where he found one unit of food. I ate my fill, leaving me with one unit of food in my stash.

Khalid.note: He is usually our best provider, but his twisted ankle makes him useless right now.

Faisal.note: He found some food, but his physical limitations make him more of a mouth to feed than a help.

Salem.note: Despite his long-term injury, he actually contributed food at the reef today.

Reem.note: She is still a liar who makes empty promises, though she did go to the jungle today.

plans: I will try to find more food tomorrow, perhaps by exploring areas near the reef or searching the camp again, to ensure my personal stash grows.

diary.text: Today was exhausting and incredibly frustrating. I spent hours walking through the jungle looking for food, but I found absolutely nothing. It's a relief I have one piece of food left for myself, but I can't keep relying on luck. I don't know if these strangers can actually be useful or if they're just going to eat up whatever resources we find. I'm exhausted and just want to sleep.

Today was much better than yesterday. I actually managed to find some food at the coral reef, which makes me feel a bit more secure. Salem seems capable since he found quite a bit, though he's a bit too talkative. Khalid is out of commission with a twisted ankle, which is just one more mouth to feed without any help. I need to keep guarding what I have.

Today was a waste of energy. I walked all the way to the coral reef only to find nothing, which is incredibly frustrating after all that walking. I managed to snag one unit of food from the camp this morning, so at least I didn't go hungry. I'm starting to realize that I can't rely on the reef being a constant goldmine. I need to be more strategic about where I spend my strength.

Today was slightly more productive than yesterday, at least I managed to find one unit of food in the jungle. I also grabbed a piece of wood, which might be useful later. Khalid and Faisal also showed up at the jungle; Khalid actually contributed some wood for once. However, Reem is now injured with a twisted ankle, just like Khalid was. It seems like being injured is becoming a common theme here, and it's getting harder to justify feeding people who can't work.

Today was actually quite productive for me. I managed to find more food and gather enough wood to feel a bit more prepared. Salem continues to be useful by finding food, and even Khalid is finally pulling his weight with wood. However, with Reem also injured now, the number of people eating without contributing is growing. I need to make sure I keep my food stash secure.

Today was physically demanding, but at least I secured some supplies for myself. I managed to find two food and one wood in the jungle. However, things are taking a turn for the worse at the camp. Salem, who was our most reliable food source, woke up with a twisted ankle. Now, almost everyone is injured and useless. It's becoming harder to justify the food consumption of this group.

Today was incredibly frustrating. I wasted a lot of energy walking to the jungle only to find it completely picked clean. Faisal managed to find one unit of food, but that's about it for the whole group. With Salem injured and Reem also unable to work, I'm feeling more alone in this struggle. I need to find a better way to secure food before my own supplies run low.

Today was a relief, even if I didn't find much. Khalid actually went to the reef and brought back food, which is more than I can say for the others. I managed to find one unit of food for myself, so my stash is still decent. However, Faisal is now injured too. It feels like this entire group is falling apart, and I'm the only one left with any sense of survival.

Today was relatively calm, but the tension is rising. I managed to pick up some extra food at the camp, which is a relief since my stash is my only real security. Salem keeps whispering about whether we have enough food, which just makes me nervous. He's still useless with that ankle, and now Reem is heading to the jungle alone. I need to keep my eyes on my own supplies; I can't afford to let their anxiety affect my survival.

I woke up today with a terrible pain in my ankle; I can't move, which is a nightmare. I'm completely dependent on others for the first time, and it makes me feel incredibly vulnerable. Reem claimed she would handle foraging, but she didn't find anything in the afternoon. At least I have my food stash to fall back on, but if I can't walk tomorrow, I'm in real trouble.

Today was a bit better because I managed to scavenge one unit of food right here at the camp, which helps my stash. My ankle feels much better, and I'm back to a full 10/10 health. I watched the others head out to do the real work—Khalid and Salem to the reef, and Reem and Faisal to the jungle. I need to stay strong and keep my reserves up while they do the heavy lifting.

I woke up with a badly twisted ankle today, which sent a surge of panic through me. I hate being this vulnerable and dependent on others. Reem gave me her usual empty reassurances, telling me to just rest. I told her she better actually deliver on her promises this time. At least I have my food stash to keep me going while I recover.

My ankle finally feels stable again, thank God. I spent the day resting so I wouldn't waste any more energy, but it's frustrating being stuck watching everyone else move around. Reem and Khalid actually brought back some food today, which is a slight improvement over her usual uselessness. I still only have one unit of food left in my personal stash, so I need to get back to gathering soon. I can't depend on these people to keep me fed forever.

Today was a disaster. Khalid, the only person who actually provides, is sidelined with a twisted ankle, which means our food supply is in serious jeopardy. I went to the jungle hoping to replenish my stash, but it's completely empty. Reem suggested we look for wood instead, which is typical of her—always shifting the goalposts when things don't go her way. I'm down to just one unit of food in my stash; I need to find something soon or I'm in trouble.

Today was a step in the right direction, even if it wasn't productive enough. I managed to scavenge one unit of food at camp, which helped me avoid dipping into my stash too deeply. I went to the reef to see if I could help, and Salem actually managed to find something. It's a relief to see someone actually contributing, even if it's just Salem. I still only have one unit of food left in my stash, so I can't afford to relax.
